description: Simple brightness, contrast and saturation, the same over the whole picture; 0 leaves each unchanged. Contrast spreads tones away from mid-gray (positive) or pulls them toward it (negative; -50 is flat gray). For photos prefer light, which also recovers highlights and shadows.
name: brightness_contrast
title: Brightness / contrast

description: Stretches the tonal range so the darkest pixel becomes black and the brightest white.
name: auto_levels
title: Auto levels

description: Histogram equalization: spreads tones evenly; strong, often harsh.
name: equalize
title: Equalization

description: Smooths away the square blocks a heavily compressed JPEG shows in skies and skin. The block grid is found from the picture, so a cropped JPEG works too; steps across block edges smaller than strength allows are spread out, larger ones are real edges and stay.
name: jpeg_artifacts

strength.description: How strong a step across a block edge may be smoothed

title: Remove JPEG artifacts

description: Spreads dark areas (erodes highlights).
name: minimum

size.description: Filter window, pixels (square)

title: Minimum

description: Spreads bright areas (erodes shadows).
name: maximum

size.description: Filter window, pixels (square)

title: Maximum

description: Keeps only edges, as dark lines on white.
name: outline
title: Contour outlining

description: Turns the picture into a pencil-like drawing.
name: hand_drawing

size.description: Filter window, pixels (square)

title: Hand drawing

description: Smooths flat areas while keeping contrasty details.
name: clean_background

size.description: Filter window, pixels (square)

title: Cleaning background

description: Pixelates into flat square tiles.
name: mosaic
title: Pixelate

description: Looks as if seen through faceted glass.
name: faceted_glass
title: Faceted glass

description: Turns the picture into irregular flat-colored cells about cell pixels across, each the average color of its pixels (like stained glass; Mosaic makes squares).
name: crystallize
title: Crystallize

description: Turns the picture into triangles whose sides follow its edges, each the average color under it (or smoothly shaded between its corners): small and many where there is detail, large where it is plain. File › Export as SVG keeps them as vectors.
name: triangulate

edges.description: How many of the picture's edges the triangles follow

shading.description: Each triangle one color, or blended between its corners

title: Triangulate

description: Raises the selection like a button: a soft bevel along its edge, lighter on the side facing the light and darker opposite. With nothing selected the whole picture becomes the button.
name: buttonize

angle.description: Light from, degrees counter-clockwise from the right

border.description: Width of the beveled edge, pixels

contrast.description: How strong the light and shade are, %

title: Buttonize

description: Cuts the selection out like a hole: the picture's edge casts a shadow into it, from the light's side. The inside is kept, filled with a color, or made transparent (only the shadow stays). With nothing selected it makes a 3D frame: a rim around the picture, the picture showing through the cut-out with the rim's shadow on it.
name: cutout

angle.description: Light from, degrees: 0 the top, 90 the left, 45 the upper left

blur.description: How soft its edge is, pixels

frame.description: With nothing selected: the frame's width, % of the picture's short side

frame_color.description: With nothing selected: the frame's color

interior.description: Inside the hole: the picture as it is, a color, or transparent

shift.description: How far the shadow falls, pixels

title: Cutout

description: Scatters pixels randomly within a window (frosted glass).
name: scatter
title: Scatter

description: Reflections in curved mirrors, waves and whirlpools. Best applied to a selection.
name: deform
title: Reflections

description: Fills the selection (or image) with a flat color.
name: fill
title: Fill with color

description: Lays small pictures along strokes drawn on the picture, like a stamp brush: a set (flowers, leaves, grass, trees, fruit, vegetables, coffee, cookies, sport, chairs and sofas), each stamp over what is there by its own transparency. Each stroke [x, y, stroke number] point lists the path the pointer traced; a stamp lands where the stroke starts and then every Spacing pixels (straight distance from the last one). Style: constant (the chosen stamp), incremental (the chosen one, then the next), random, angular (by the stroke's direction).
name: picture_hose

angle_jitter.description: Each stamp turned at random, up to this share of a half turn, %

size.description: Size of the stamps, %

size_jitter.description: Each stamp up to this much smaller, at random, %

stamp.description: The stamp to start from (Constant and Incremental)

strokes.description: Points [x, y, stroke] of the strokes, image pixels, in order

title: Picture hose

description: Draws a line along the edge of the selection: its width in pixels, its color, and whether it sits on the edge, inside it or outside it. Needs a selection (a circle or rectangle around something, an underline).
name: stroke

position.description: center = on the edge, inside, outside

title: Stroke selection

description: Fills with a natural, grainy variation of a color.
name: fill_fluctuated
title: Fluctuated color

description: Fills with a gradient from one point to another, as the Gradient tool draws it: from the from color at the first point to the to color at the second; linear along the line, radial outward from the first point, reflected both ways from it.
name: gradient_line
title: Gradient between points

description: Draws a shape between two points, as the Shape tool does: a rectangle, a rounded rectangle or an ellipse in the box the points span, or a line or an arrow (its head at the second point) from the first point to the second. Antialiased, with a stroke of the given width and color (a width of 0 draws no stroke on the closed shapes) and, with fill on, the inside in the fill color. For marking up a screenshot: a box around something, an arrow pointing at it.
name: shape

points.description: Opposite corners of the box, or a line's start and end, pixels

title: Shape

description: Mirrors the selection or image.
name: flip
title: Flip

description: Changes the image size. Give width and/or height; a missing one keeps the proportions.
name: resize
title: Resize image

description: Adds a frame around the picture, the same width on every side, in the background color. On layers above the bottom one the frame is transparent.
name: border

size.description: Border width on each side, pixels

title: Add border

description: Puts a textured frame and a mat around the picture, growing the canvas for them, on a new layer "Frame" with a hole over the picture: oak, walnut, cherry, maple, mahogany, ebony and driftwood, bark, frost, paper, agate, malachite, marble, granite and other materials, drawn for the frame's size in each texture's colors, each side its own piece meeting the next at a mitered corner, shaded so they look lit from the light's side; a mat in a color, with a beveled cut edge. Sizes are relative to the picture's long side (Small 1/32, Medium 1/16, Large 1/8).
name: frame

frame.description: Frame texture: wood and nature (bark_1 … winter), paper (bonedry … rainform), stone (agate … stone), or none

frame_size.description: Frame width: 1/32, 1/16 or 1/8 of the long side

mat_size.description: Mat width: none, 1/32, 1/16 or 1/8 of the long side

title: Frames

description: Changes the canvas without resampling the picture: a new width and height (0 keeps one), with the picture kept at the anchor, so the canvas grows or is trimmed on the other sides. relative: width and height are pixels added (negative trims). New area is the background color on the bottom layer and transparent above.
name: canvas_size

height.description: New height, pixels (0 keeps it); with relative, pixels added

relative.description: Width and height are added to the current size

width.description: New width, pixels (0 keeps it); with relative, pixels added

title: Canvas size

description: Rotates the whole image counter-clockwise; the canvas grows to fit.
name: rotate
title: Rotate image

description: Crops to a rectangle (or, with no rectangle, to the selection's bounds). angle turns the picture inside the crop (counter-clockwise, about the crop's center), to straighten while cropping.
name: crop

angle.description: Turn inside the crop, degrees counter-clockwise

background.description: Where the turned picture leaves gaps

out_height.description: Then resize to this height (0 = as cropped)

out_width.description: Then resize to this width (0 = as cropped)

title: Crop

description: Softens the picture. gaussian: a smooth blur of `radius` pixels; box: averages each `size` x `size` window; focus: negative values sharpen, positive blur.
name: blur

size.description: box: window, pixels

title: Blur

description: Blurs along a straight line, as if the camera or the subject moved: each pixel becomes the average along distance pixels at angle degrees (counter-clockwise from horizontal).
name: motion_blur
title: Motion blur

description: Removes noise, specks and grain. edge_preserving (default): averages only similar neighbors, for the grain of a dark or high-ISO photo; edge_preserving_contrast: the same plus a contrast boost; median: removes specks, dust and scratches, keeping edges; specks: replaces only isolated outlier pixels; harmonic: removes bright specks, keeping dark detail.
name: reduce_noise

gap.description: specks, edge preserving: how many levels count as similar

method.description: How to find and remove noise

size.description: Window, pixels (median: at most 15)

title: Reduce noise

description: Removes dust, specks and thin scratches, as on a scan: a pixel is replaced by the median of the square radius pixels around it, but only where it differs from that median by more than threshold. Raise radius until the dust goes, then threshold until the texture comes back.
name: dust_and_scratches

radius.description: Size of the specks to remove, pixels

threshold.description: How different a pixel must be to count as dust

title: Dust & scratches

description: Remaps tones through a curve given by points [input, output] (0..255). Endpoints default to [0,0] and [255,255]; e.g. [[64,48],[192,208]] adds contrast. The smooth curve never overshoots its points. Channel luminosity changes lightness only, keeping colors.
name: curves

channel.description: Which channel the curve applies to

smooth.description: Smooth curve through the points (else straight segments)

title: Curves

description: Bends the selection with a grid: each move [x, y, dx, dy] drags the grid node nearest to (x, y), in image pixels, by (dx, dy).
name: warp

moves.description: Node moves [x, y, dx, dy], image pixels

title: Warp

description: Reshapes the picture by hand, as Photoshop's Liquify: Forward Warp pushes what is under the brush along a drag; Pucker draws it toward the brush's middle, Bloat away from it; Twirl turns it (clockwise or counterclockwise); Reconstruct brings back the original; Freeze protects an area from every later stroke, Thaw undoes that. Each stroke [tool, x, y, dx, dy] (tool: 0 forward warp, 1 pucker, 2 bloat, 3 twirl clockwise, 4 twirl counterclockwise, 5 reconstruct, 6 freeze, 7 thaw) runs from (x, y) by (dx, dy); all but the warp dab along it (once for a click). Strongest at the brush's middle, fading to nothing at its edge, scaled by pressure.
name: liquify

pressure.description: How far of each push the picture moves, %

pushes.description: Forward Warp pushes [x, y, dx, dy], image pixels (before the strokes)

size.description: Brush size, pixels

strokes.description: Strokes [tool, x, y, dx, dy], image pixels, in order

tool.description: The tool the next drags on the picture use

title: Liquify

description: Grabs the point (from_x, from_y) and stretches the selection like rubber so it lands on (to_x, to_y).
name: rubber
title: Rubber

description: Displaces pixels by a profile you draw: points [position 0..255, displacement -128..127], interpolated in between.
name: custom_deform

direction.description: Along which axis the profile runs

title: Custom deformation

description: Pixel arithmetic with another open image of the same size.
name: calculate

other.description: Second operand (id of an open image)

title: Image calculator

description: Joins another open image to this one (panoramas, side-by-side comparisons). The image grows to fit both.
name: stitch

offset.description: Shift along the joined edge, pixels

other.description: Image to attach (id of an open image)

transparency.description: Transparency of the attached image where they overlap, %

title: Stitch

description: Builds a color image from three grayscale images used as channels (R,G,B or H,S,V or C,M,Y); replaces this image.
name: combine_channels

first.description: Red / hue / cyan channel (id of an open image)

second.description: Green / saturation / magenta channel (id of an open image)

third.description: Blue / value / yellow channel (id of an open image)

title: Combine channels

description: Reduces each color channel to a few flat levels, poster-like.
name: posterize
title: Posterize

description: Turns the picture into raised square tiles with beveled edges.
name: mosaic_3d
title: 3D mosaic

description: Explodes the picture outward from the center in sharp, star-like spikes.
name: burst
title: Burst

description: Like burst, but with rounded, petal-like lobes.
name: blot
title: Blot

description: The picture collapses inward toward the center in sharp spikes.
name: earthquake
title: Earthquake

description: The picture collapses inward in rounded lobes, as if sinking.
name: quicksands
title: Quicksands

description: The picture bursts outward from its middle: smeared along uneven rays, blown out toward the edges, with droplets of color flung past the burst.
name: splash

droplets.description: How many droplets are flung out

size.description: How far the burst reaches, % of the area

title: Splash

description: A black hole in the middle of the picture: the picture bent around it as gravity bends light (turned over in a ring hugging it), swirled around it, with a bright ring of light at its edge.
name: black_hole

pull.description: How strongly it bends the picture

ring.description: How bright the ring of light around it is

size.description: Size of the black hole, % of the area's shorter side

swirl.description: How much it turns the picture around itself

title: Black hole

description: Paints the picture in watercolor, in its own colors: transparent washes over white paper (the lightest areas are the paper), keeping to the picture's edges and bleeding into each other where wet, blooms with ragged dark edges, darker where a wash dried, pigment settling in the paper's grain.
name: watercolor

edges.description: How dark the dried edges of the washes are

granulation.description: How much pigment settles into the paper's grain

paper.description: How much the paper's texture shows

size.description: Size of the washes, pixels (0: from the picture's size)

wetness.description: How wet: bleeding between washes, and blooms

title: Watercolor

description: Draws the picture in soft chalk pastel: blended diagonal strokes that keep the edges, lighter softer color, the paper's grain showing through.
name: pastel

detail.description: How much of the picture's detail the chalk keeps

paper.description: How much the paper's tooth shows through the chalk

size.description: Width of the strokes, pixels (0: from the picture's size)

strength.description: How much of the result replaces the picture

title: Pastel

description: Draws the picture with wax crayons: strokes in one direction with visible hatching, flat saturated color across each stroke, dark areas gone over again at other angles, the paper showing through.
name: crayons

paper.description: How much the paper's tooth breaks up the wax

pressure.description: How hard the crayon is pressed: how much wax

size.description: Width of the strokes, pixels (0: from the picture's size)

strength.description: How much of the result replaces the picture

title: Crayons

description: Paint runs downward as if the picture were wet.
name: gravity

strength.description: Length of drips, %; negative runs upward (gravity only)

title: Running paint: drips

description: Wet paint is blown sideways.
name: wind

strength.description: Length of drips, %; negative runs upward (gravity only)

title: Running paint: wind

description: Paint is washed away in a direction, leaving streaks.
name: wash_out

strength.description: Length of drips, %; negative runs upward (gravity only)

title: Running paint: wash out

description: Pixels fly off in a direction like a sandstorm.
name: pixel_storm
title: Pixel storm

description: Rebuilds the picture from embossed patches, like a quilt or collage.
name: patches

size.description: Patch size, pixels

title: Patches

description: Overlays a surface texture: canvas, cracks, tile mosaic, quilted padding, noise or slate.
name: texture

strength.description: Relief, % of the texture's own; 0 = none

title: Texture

description: Rings spreading on still water from the middle of the picture, seen at a slant, the picture seen as its reflection on them: moved along each ring's slope, slopes facing the light lighter, the crests glinting; calm at the very middle, fading outward.
name: pond_ripples

rings.description: How many rings fit from the middle to a corner

shine.description: How much the water catches the light

spread.description: How far the rings reach before they fade

tilt.description: How flat the water is seen: 0 from above (round rings)

title: Pond ripples

description: The picture as seen through a window with frost on it: frost grows from the edges and corners and thins toward the middle, blurring and bending the picture and whitening it cold with feathery crystals, while the middle and strokes of a finger stay clear.
name: frost

chill.description: How cold and blue the frost is

clear.description: How far the middle is clear of frost (0: frost all over)

size.description: Width of the crystals, pixels (0: from the picture's size)

wipes.description: How many strokes of a finger have wiped the glass

title: Frosted window

description: The picture as seen through hammered, rippled glass: the glass is a field of lenses, so the picture is bent and smeared along the ripples, liquid-looking, while the surface catches the light with glints along the crests; the ripples can be drawn out into long streaks running down the glass.
name: rippled_glass

shine.description: How much the glass catches the light

size.description: Size of the ripples, pixels (0: from the picture's size)

strength.description: How far the glass bends the picture

stretch.description: How much the ripples are drawn out into streaks running down the glass (0: round)

title: Rippled glass

description: The picture as seen through a window with rain on it: drops of many sizes, each a small lens showing the sharp picture behind it turned over, some trickled down leaving wavy trails of clear glass, the rest of the glass misted. Streams make the glass flooded: long rivulets run down it as thin clear lenses, a sheet of water smears the picture downward, and the streams bend the picture's geometry around them.
name: rain

flood.description: How flooded the glass is: a sheet of water that smears the picture downward

mist.description: How misted the glass is between the drops

size.description: Size of the large drops, pixels (0: from the picture's size)

streams.description: How many long rivulets run down the glass

trickles.description: How many drops have run down

warp.description: How much the streams bend the picture's geometry around them

title: Rain

description: The picture as seen through textured glass, as Photoshop's Glass: frosted, glass blocks, canvas or tiny lenses, generated (frosted and blocks never repeat), the picture bent along the glass's slope.
name: glass

distortion.description: How strongly the glass bends the picture

title: Glass

description: The picture as areas of flat color: Matisse (as his Fauvist paintings and cut-outs: few areas in bold, nearly pure colors, shadows violet and blue, no outlines), Tarkay (more areas in rich jewel tones, each held by a dark contour) Hokusai (an ukiyo-e woodblock print: muted pigments, thin ink lines, graded skies, paper grain) Lichtenstein (pop art: primaries, Ben-Day dots, thick black outlines) Mondrian (rectangles of white, grey, black and primaries in black bars) or Warhol (a silkscreen: four flat tones in bold colors, black ink off register).
name: flat_color

colors.description: How many colors (0: the style's own)

simplify.description: How much the shapes are simplified

title: Flat color

description: Paints the picture with brush strokes: Impressionist (as Monet: short broken dabs of shifting color in layers), Pointillist (as Seurat: dots of pure pigments that the eye mixes) Van Gogh (long swirling strokes in strong color, thick impasto) Cézanne (short parallel strokes in patches, warm lights and cool shadows) Signac (larger oblong dabs of pure pigments, like a mosaic) Munch (long rolling bands of intensified color, dark contours) or Turner (watercolor: soft washes, darker rims, granulation, golden light), the strokes following the picture's shapes, the paint's relief lit from the upper left.
name: painting

brush.description: Brush size, pixels (0: from the picture's size)

detail.description: How closely the finer strokes follow the picture

style.description: Painter whose way of painting is followed

title: Painting

description: Lays the picture in mosaic tiles, as Photoshop's Mosaic Tiles: squarish tiles in courses that follow the picture's edges, each the color under it, set in grout; none alike, nothing repeating.
name: mosaic_tiles

grout_width.description: Width of the grout between them, pixels

title: Mosaic tiles

description: The crack network of old paint over the picture, as Photoshop's Craquelure: irregular cracks that never repeat around slightly raised islands of paint, with a finer network in places.
name: craquelure

crack_depth.description: How deep and wide the cracks are

crack_spacing.description: Size of the islands between cracks, pixels

title: Craquelure

description: Fills with a color modulated by a natural pattern: fluctuated (grain), fractured (random grain cells), eroded, fractal clouds or complex fractal.
name: fill_texture
title: Fill with textured color

description: Fills with a smooth transition between two colors.
name: gradient

angle.description: Direction for `angle`, degrees counter-clockwise from the right

direction.description: vertical goes bottom to top, horizontal left to right, radial/elliptic center outward, angle uses `angle`, fractal is cloudy

title: Gradient

description: Fills with the spectrum of colors, in any gradient shape.
name: rainbow

direction.description: vertical goes bottom to top, horizontal left to right, radial/elliptic center outward, angle uses `angle`, fractal is cloudy

title: Rainbow

description: Repaints the picture in oil, respecting its edges: paint flattened into patches that stretch along the shapes and never run over an edge, bristle streaks following the shapes, and raised paint lit from the upper left.
name: oil_paint

bristles.description: How strong the bristle streaks are, %

size.description: Brush size, pixels (0: from the picture's size)

title: Oil paint

description: Repaints the picture in gouache, respecting its edges: opaque, matte paint in flat areas that keep to the picture's edges, a little chalky, strokes showing in the color and a faint paper grain.
name: gouache

flatness.description: How far the tones are gathered into flat areas, %

size.description: Brush size, pixels (0: from the picture's size)

title: Gouache

description: Turns the picture into a pen-hatched engraving, in black and white or in an 8-color look.
name: graphic_pen

threshold.description: Darkness above which strokes are drawn

title: Graphic pen

description: Gray relief, as if the picture were pressed into clay.
name: relief

size.description: Window size in pixels (odd; even values round up)

title: Relief

description: Relief that keeps the picture's colors.
name: color_relief

size.description: Window size in pixels (odd; even values round up)

title: Color relief

description: Coats the picture in wax of a color: each pixel is mixed with the color by coating percent, then darkened along the picture's edges, where the wax gathers.
name: hot_wax

coating.description: How much of the wax color, %

title: Hot wax

description: Curls a corner of the picture (or selection) like a page being turned.
name: page_curl

amount.description: How far the page is curled, %

corner.description: Which corner curls, and from which side

title: Page curl

description: Organic random distortion: excitation (jelly-like wobble), erosion (ragged, eaten edges) or ripples (water surface).
name: random_deform

grain.description: Grain size, pixels; 0 = the kind's default (8, 7 or 32)

title: Random deformation

description: Geometric distortion of the selection: whirl, wave, concave or convex lens.
name: pure_deform

direction.description: Whirl: clockwise/counterclockwise; others: horizontal/vertical/radial; auto picks clockwise or radial

size.description: Size of waves or of the whirl

title: Pure deformation

description: Moves the corners of the selection: skew (sideways), perspective (narrow one side) or free.
name: distort

bottom_left_x.description: Corner move, per-mille of the area's width (x) or height (y); +x right, +y down

bottom_left_y.description: Corner move, per-mille of the area's width (x) or height (y); +x right, +y down

bottom_right_x.description: Corner move, per-mille of the area's width (x) or height (y); +x right, +y down

bottom_right_y.description: Corner move, per-mille of the area's width (x) or height (y); +x right, +y down

top_left_x.description: Corner move, per-mille of the area's width (x) or height (y); +x right, +y down

top_left_y.description: Corner move, per-mille of the area's width (x) or height (y); +x right, +y down

top_right_x.description: Corner move, per-mille of the area's width (x) or height (y); +x right, +y down

top_right_y.description: Corner move, per-mille of the area's width (x) or height (y); +x right, +y down

title: Distort

description: Rotates the selected area in place around its center (the image keeps its size).
name: rotate_selection
title: Rotate area

description: Shifts hues around the color wheel and changes saturation, contrast and brightness. Defaults change nothing. Contrast spreads tones away from mid-gray above 50 and pulls them toward it below 50 (0 is flat gray).
name: hue_saturation

saturation.description: Saturation at the same lightness; -255 = gray, 255 = fully saturated, about ±60 is a moderate change

title: Hue / saturation

description: Corrects the picture in one step, by its kind: Auto levels, colors or contrast from the picture's own tones, or a scene (light or heavy shadow, inside with flash or in a room, daylight bright or cloudy, faded) with a tone curve made for it.
name: smart_tune

type.description: What kind of picture, or which automatic correction

title: Smart tune

description: Tints the picture with one color, like a duotone or sepia print (try #704214 for sepia).
name: colorize
title: Colorize

description: Relief look lit from a direction, on a flat color.
name: emboss

angle.description: Light direction, degrees counter-clockwise from the right

title: Emboss

description: Classic sharpening: boosts the difference between each pixel and its local mean. preset mild or strong: a fixed gentle or strong sharpening (amount and size are not used).
name: unsharp_mask

preset.description: custom: amount and size; mild or strong: fixed sharpening

size.description: Window size in pixels (odd; even values round up)

title: Unsharp mask

description: A predefined 5x5 convolution: smoothing, sharpening, directional emboss (compass directions) or Laplace edge detection.
name: custom_filter
title: Custom filter

description: Adaptive sharpening that leaves flat areas (skin, sky) alone and sharpens edges.
name: smartsharp

size.description: Window size in pixels (odd; even values round up)

title: Smartsharp

description: Removes moire and halftone dots from scanned printed pictures.
name: demoire

size.description: Window size in pixels (odd; even values round up)

title: Demoire

description: Smooths and tones skin in portraits, leaving everything not colored like the picked skin color alone.
name: skin_makeup
title: Skin makeup

description: Whitens teeth: pulls the yellow out and lifts the lightness, sparing red lips and gums and the dark between teeth. Select the teeth first (an operation works on the selection).
name: whiten_teeth

whiten.description: How much yellow to take out, %

title: Whiten teeth

description: Brightens the whites of the eyes, taking a little color out of them, and adds local contrast to the iris and lashes, leaving the dark pupil alone. Select the eyes first (an operation works on the selection).
name: brighten_eyes

detail.description: Local contrast of the iris and lashes, %

title: Brighten eyes

description: Removes dust from a scan: specks darker (or lighter) than what is around them by more than Gap are replaced by the median of their neighborhood; a large dark or light area is left alone. Needs an area at least 30 pixels each way.
name: dust_cleaner

dust.description: Dark specks (dust on a print or slide) or light ones (dust on a negative)

gap.description: How much darker or lighter than around it a speck must be

strength.description: How far around a speck the repair looks

title: Dust cleaner

description: Removes scratches from a scanned print, slide or negative: thin lines in any direction, lighter or darker than the picture (brightness scratches) or bluish or yellowish (color scratches), filled in from the clean pixels beside them. Needs an area at least 30 pixels each way.
name: scratch_removal

scanned_from.description: A negative (its scratches are light) or a print or slide (dark)

title: Scratch removal

description: Removes long thin scratches that run across a scanned film frame, horizontally or vertically, by filling them in from the rows beside them. Needs an area at least 64 pixels each way.
name: reel_scratches

negative.description: Scanned from a negative (light scratches); off for a print or positive (dark scratches)

title: Remove reel scratches

description: Focus that changes from the center of the selection to its edges: e.g. sharp face, dreamy blurred surroundings.
name: soft_focus

inner.description: At the center: negative sharpens, positive blurs

outer.description: At the edges: negative sharpens, positive blurs

title: Soft focus

description: Smears the picture sideways as if blown away by wind, fading into a color.
name: wind_out

fade.description: What it fades into: the picture's own average color, or a color you choose

title: Wind out

description: Re-draws the picture with short brush strokes along similar colors.
name: strokes

tolerance.description: Color tolerance of a stroke, levels

title: Strokes

description: A medal-like engraved relief.
name: engrave
title: Engrave

description: Posterized drawing on grainy, embossed paper.
name: note_paper
title: Note paper

description: Sets the black point, white point and midtone brightness (gamma), then the output range: values at or below in_black become out_black, at or above in_white become out_white. luminosity changes lightness only.
name: levels
title: Levels

description: Exposure, contrast and tone, as in a photo editor's Basic panel: exposure in stops (linear light); highlights and shadows recover or lift bright and dark areas locally without halos; whites and blacks move the end points. All 0 changes nothing.
name: light
title: Light

description: Adds (or with negative values softens) mid-scale contrast, which brings out texture and structure without halos.
name: clarity
title: Clarity

description: Removes a color cast. auto estimates the light from the picture; neutral makes the given color (pick a gray in the picture) neutral; manual sets temperature (+ warmer, − cooler) and tint (+ magenta, − green).
name: white_balance

neutral.description: neutral: a color that should be gray

strength.description: How much of the correction to apply, %

title: White balance

description: Vibrance saturates dull colors most and spares skin tones; saturation changes all colors alike (−100 is black and white). Works on perceptual chroma, so hues and lightness stay.
name: vibrance
title: Vibrance / saturation

description: Smooths the colored blotches of a high-ISO photo and leaves its lightness, and so its detail, alone. Amount: how much of the smoothed color replaces the original; Radius: how far the color is averaged, in pixels; Edge protection: how strictly only neighbors of a similar lightness and color count, so edges keep their color.
name: reduce_color_noise
title: Reduce color noise

description: Hue, saturation and luminance for one color range at a time (reds, oranges, yellows, greens, aquas, blues, purples, magentas), as in a photo editor's HSL panel: deepen a blue sky without touching the greens, turn foliage toward yellow, calm a red jacket. Each slider goes from −100 to 100; hue turns the range up to 30° either way. Grays stay as they are.
name: color_mixer
title: Color mixer

description: Converts to black and white with a filter per color, as in Photoshop: each slider sets how bright that color turns out (%). Presets imitate colored lens filters; choose custom to use the sliders. Optional toning tints the midtones.
name: black_and_white
title: Black & white

description: Turns the picture into its negative: each color becomes its opposite (black ↔ white).
name: invert
title: Invert

description: Removes blemishes, dust and small distractions: each spot [x, y, radius] is filled from the best-matching texture nearby, blended seamlessly into its surroundings.
name: heal

spots.description: Spots to heal: [[x, y, radius], …] in pixels

title: Heal spots

description: Gives the picture (or the selection) the color and brightness of another open image: its average and spread of lightness and color (in OKLab). For a pasted element in a layered picture, use layer match_below instead.
name: match_colors

brightness.description: Match brightness and contrast too (else color only)

reference.description: The image whose colors to take (id of an open image)

title: Match colors

description: Removes what is selected (a person, a sign, a wire) and fills in what plausibly was behind it, with an on-device model. Select the object first (select shape object or subject works well); expand grows the selection to catch edges and shadows.
name: remove_object

expand.description: Grow the selection by this many pixels

model.description: best: LaMa, for large objects and texture; fast: MI-GAN, a smaller download

title: Remove object

description: Removes red eye from flash photos: round red pupils turn dark, the catchlight stays. Works in the selection (select around the eyes) or, carefully, the whole picture.
name: red_eye
title: Red eye removal

description: Corrects converging lines: vertical > 0 makes lines that lean together toward the top (a building shot from below) parallel, < 0 toward the bottom; horizontal does the same left/right. The frame keeps its size; uncovered edges get the background.
name: keystone
title: Perspective (keystone)

description: Straightens lines a lens bent: amount > 0 removes barrel distortion (lines bulging outward, from a wide-angle or phone lens), < 0 removes pincushion (lines pinched inward). The middle stays; the change grows toward the edges. scale enlarges (fills the frame) or shrinks (keeps all of the picture); uncovered edges get the background.
name: lens_distortion
title: Lens distortion

description: Split toning, as in a photo editor's Color Grading: tints the shadows with one color and the highlights with another (lightness stays); balance moves the split toward the shadows (−) or highlights (+); fade lifts the blacks for a matte, filmic print.
name: color_grade
title: Color grading

description: Lightens (dodge, amount > 0) or darkens (burn, amount < 0) the tones of one range, like Photoshop's Dodge and Burn: pick the brush and this effect to paint it on. Shadows, midtones or highlights are changed most where they are lightest or darkest for that range, and the rest is left alone.
name: dodge_burn
title: Dodge and burn

description: Darkens (amount < 0) or lightens (> 0) the picture toward its corners, drawing the eye to the middle; size sets how much of the middle stays untouched.
name: vignette

amount.description: Negative darkens the corners (a usual vignette is -30); positive lightens them

size.description: Untouched middle, %

title: Vignette

description: Adds film grain: strongest in the midtones, gentle in deep shadows and highlights, with a size that follows the picture. roughness runs from soft clumps to fine speckle; color from monochrome to independent color grain. The same picture, settings and seed always give the same grain.
name: grain

size.description: Grain size (relative to the picture)

title: Film grain

description: The bright parts bleed soft light into their surroundings, like a diffusion filter or a bloom. spread is relative to the picture; threshold sets how bright counts as bright.
name: glow
title: Glow

description: Light scattering back through film: the bright parts bleed a tinted halo (red-orange by default), wider than a glow.
name: halation
title: Halation

description: A one-click style made of several adjustments (light, color, grading, black and white), at the given strength: vivid, golden_hour, cool_morning, cinematic (teal and orange), faded_film, matte, punchy, dreamy, autumn, noir, silver (soft black and white), sepia; modern styles: portra, airy, moody, pastel, neon, bleach_bypass, polaroid, summer, fresh, rose_gold, dramatic, dramatic_cool, mono, chrome, blue_hour, sunset; film looks: cinestill, disposable, y2k_flash, dream_glow.
name: look
title: Look

description: Blurs the background (or foreground) by how far it is from the focus, like a wide-aperture lens, using the depth of the scene seen by an on-device model. focus: [[x, y]] in pixels, the point to keep sharp (click on the picture); none focuses on the middle. range: how much depth around the focus stays sharp. bokeh: bright points become bright discs.
name: lens_blur

amount.description: Blur of what is farthest from the focus, pixels

focus.description: The point in focus, [[x, y]]; none: the middle

range.description: Depth kept sharp around the focus, %

title: Lens blur

description: Shifts the colors of the shadows, midtones and highlights separately, as in Photoshop: each between cyan and red, magenta and green, yellow and blue (−100..100). preserve_luminosity keeps each pixel's lightness.
name: color_balance
title: Color balance

description: Makes each output channel from percentages of the red, green and blue channels plus a constant, as in Photoshop; monochrome makes a gray picture from the red row.
name: channel_mixer
title: Channel mixer

description: Changes the cyan, magenta, yellow and black in one color range at a time, as in Photoshop: ranges [[range, cyan, magenta, yellow, black], …] with range 0 reds, 1 yellows, 2 greens, 3 cyans, 4 blues, 5 magentas, 6 whites, 7 neutrals, 8 blacks and amounts −100..100. relative scales by the ink already there; absolute adds.
name: selective_color
title: Selective color

description: Replaces each pixel's lightness by a color from a gradient, darkest to lightest: stops [[position 0..100, red, green, blue], …]; reverse runs it backwards. No stops: black to white.
name: gradient_map
title: Gradient map

description: Makes the picture black and white: pixels at least as light as level become white, the others black.
name: threshold
title: Threshold

description: Applies a 3D color lookup table (a film emulation or grade from a .cube file): size N and table, N³ colors [[red, green, blue], …] 0..1 with red changing fastest. No table: unchanged.
name: color_lookup

size.description: Table size N

title: Color lookup

description: One-step improvement: removes a color cast, stretches the tonal range, sets exposure, adds a little clarity and vibrance. strength scales it all.
name: auto_enhance
title: Auto enhance

description: Enlarges the picture 2, 3 or 4 times with an on-device model that draws sharp, natural detail instead of blur.
name: upscale
title: Enlarge (AI)

description: Straightens a quadrilateral into a rectangle, e.g. a document, painting or screen photographed at an angle: give its four corners [[x, y], …] in the order top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left; the result is that region, flat, at its average size.
name: perspective
title: Perspective (corners)

description: Levels a tilted picture: turns it by angle (counter-clockwise, degrees) and, with crop, cuts it to the largest rectangle of the same proportions without empty corners. With auto, the tilt is found from the picture's long straight edges (a horizon, a building's sides) and angle is not used; it says so if there are none to go by.
name: straighten

auto.description: Find the tilt from the horizon and straight edges

background.description: Color of the corners when not cropping

title: Straighten
